deadline.value: The department says it has no formal application deadline.
deadline.quote: We do not have formal Application Deadlines

gre_general.value: GRE General scores may be submitted but are not required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores may be submitted, but are not required

gre_subject.value: Chemistry Subject GRE scores may be provided but are not required.
gre_subject.quote: Results of GRE General or Chemistry Subject Exam scores may be provided, but are NOT required

toefl_min.value: The department recommends an approximate TOEFL iBT minimum of 92 for applicants whose first language is not English.
toefl_min.quote: The recommended minimum scores are (approximately): TOEFL IBT-92

fee_waiver.value: For the Fall 2027 Chemistry PhD, the application fee waiver is for US citizens and permanent residents only.
fee_waiver.quote: For a limited time, US citizens and permanent residents seeking admission to the Fall 2027 Chemistry Ph.D. program will receive an application fee waiver

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need to name an adviser; students choose one at the end of their first semester.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to identify my research advisor (or research project) before I join the PhD program? No!

funding.value: All students accepted into the PhD receive a teaching or research assistantship for the duration of their studies.
funding.quote: all students accepted into the program are provided with financial support for the duration of their studies

entry_route.value: Not stated on the official pages reached for this field.

notes: The department FAQ says there are no formal deadlines; the Graduate School page lists January 1. Department TOEFL figure is a recommendation ('approximately').
